gen-gf-tektur-gf-gafata: Pipe-cleaner strokes with wide-open curve endings give Tektur its wiry swagger. Tektur is best at being loud and oversized, while Gafata does its quiet work through tall, wide-eyed lowercase that keeps lines tidy.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-huninn: Tektur draws wiry, outsized lowercase with generous openings on every curve. Huninn takes over for paragraphs with sturdy crossbars and lowercase rising close to cap height, so text feels dense and steady.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-khula: Tektur bends every stroke like wire, with zero modulation. It earns its keep big and short, while Khula, modern and tall-bellied, with open-mouthed curves, carries the quieter work beneath.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-nokora: Bent-wire curves, generous openings: Tektur looks drawn with a pipe cleaner. But where Tektur turns heads, Nokora lays down a thick, dark stripe of lowercase and a generous s that keeps lines readable.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Expressive from the first glyph, Tektur looks cut from equal-width strips. Tektur is best at showing off, while Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings apart and its c, s and z tall and full.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Wiry, outsized, stubbornly hairline-free: Tektur is all stems and generous curve openings. Noto Sans Balinese brings the breathing space inside each curved glyph, and that mix of wire and room is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Distinctive and wiry, Tektur has no thick-and-thin contrast to slow the eye. But Noto Sans Bassa Vah settles into paragraphs easily, its dominant midsection and open-jawed c giving lines a dense, steady rhythm.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian stops its curves short and pairs a large x-height with short ascenders. Tektur, meanwhile, is best at counters framed by same-width strokes, loud where the body is quiet.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Tektur carves every letter part to the same visual mass, wiry and oversized. Noto Sans Cuneiform then reads with puffy, glass-bead lowercase and an e that opens up, which keeps paragraphs light and clear.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Expressive down to its thread-thin lines, Tektur has no swelling or tapering anywhere in its wiry, oversized lowercase. Noto Sans Devanagari adds a compact skyline and open g beneath it.
